crossRefs.note: Give your servant therefore an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and evil; for…
Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.
Your hands have made me and formed me. Give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.
so as to turn your ear to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;
Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.
Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.
But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be…
who may go out before them, and who may come in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in, that…
He said to them, “I am one hundred twenty years old today. I can no more go out and come in. Yahweh has said to me…
In times past, when Saul was king over us, it was you who led Israel out and in. Yahweh said to you, ‘You will be…
to the one a stench from death to death, to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these…
not that we are sufficient of ourselves, to account anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency is from God,

translations.web: Now give me wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people; for who can judge this great people of yours?”
translations.bsb: Now grant me wisdom and knowledge, so that I may lead this people. For who is able to govern this great people of Yours?”
translations.kjv: Give me now wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people: for who can judge this thy people, that is so great?
translations.asv: Give me now wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people; for who can judge this thy people, that is so great?
